action: Ear sphere has a Mirror modifier (mirror object = head) so one ear makes both; flattens it into an ear disc with Grab in right view.
why: symmetric ears without duplicating by hand
reader_equivalent: bpy: ear.modifiers.new('Mirror','MIRROR'); mirror_object=head; then sculpt_strokes brush=grab to flatten

action: Switches to the Draw brush (small radius) and carves eye sockets and nose base; mesh now looks voxel-remeshed (blocky high-density).
why: carve sockets after enough resolution exists
reader_equivalent: sculpt_remesh head; sculpt_strokes brush=draw invert=true around eye sockets

action: Reshapes ear and face planes with Grab, pulls nose out and cheek mass, from user/front perspective.
why: primary forms of nose, cheeks, brow
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes brush=grab small moves on nose tip outward, cheeks forward

action: Draw brush cuts almond eye openings and lid lines; Grab shapes the nostril and mouth.
why: eye openings and mouth before placing eyeballs
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes brush=draw invert=true radius small along eye outline; brush=grab on mouth

action: Grab on nose and side of jaw; Crease Polish brush defines the ear rim.
why: sharpen ear folds and jaw line
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes brush=crease along ear helix; brush=grab jaw

action: An eyeball sphere sits in the socket; lids pulled over it with Grab.
reader_equivalent: add_sphere eye_L into socket (mirror modifier), sculpt_strokes brush=grab on lid edges

action: Both eyeballs visible; refines lid shapes with Grab and adds mouth corners / lips with Clay Strips.
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes brush=grab lids; brush=clay_strips short strokes on lip corners

action: Object Mode with head selected shows Subdivision (Catmull-Clark) and Mirror modifiers on the head.
why: smooth display and X symmetry by modifier, not sculpt symmetry

action: Back on head: Grab tweaks of nose, mouth corners and ear with small radius.
why: likeness/proportion fixes after hair is in
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes brush=grab small radius on mouth corners

action: Eyebrows from a Plane edited in Edit Mode, with Subdivision, Mirror, Shrinkwrap (target Sphere = head) and Solidify modifiers.
tool: Edit Mode on Plane + modifier stack
why: clean card-like brows that hug the face
reader_equivalent: bpy: add plane, extrude strip along brow, add SUBSURF, MIRROR, SHRINKWRAP target=head, SOLIDIFY

action: Close-up Draw brush pass on lips, nostrils and lid creases.
why: secondary detail on mouth and nose
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes brush=draw small radius on lip line, invert on nostrils

action: Draw on nose/lips, Grab on lip corner, then Clay Strips under the eye.
tool: Sculpt Mode / Draw, Grab, Clay Strips

action: Grab on jaw/cheek outline and on hair edge to tidy the silhouette.
Eyelash/upper-lid line from a second Plane (Plane.001) extruded along the lid in Edit Mode (Extrude Region and Move), with Subdivision, Mirror, Shrinkwrap, Solidify.
tool: Edit Mode / Extrude Region and Move + modifiers
why: dark lash line card that follows the lid
reader_equivalent: bpy: plane strip, extrude along lid verts, SHRINKWRAP target=head, SOLIDIFY, MIRROR

action: Crease Polish on cheek/nose fold, then Grab on fringe locks.
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes brush=crease strength 0.25; brush=grab on hair

action: Sculpts the ear on a mirrored object with Inflate/Deflate and Draw; the Mirror modifier panel is open.
tool: Sculpt Mode / Inflate/Deflate, Draw; Mirror modifier
why: build ear volume once and mirror it to the other side
reader_equivalent: sculpt_strokes brush=inflate then draw on ear; bpy: modifiers.new('Mirror','MIRROR')

action: Grabs the ear shape and hair edge around it with Grab.
why: tuck the ear under the hair and fix its outline

action: Refines the lips, nostrils and eyelid with Crease Polish and Draw in close-up.
why: late detail pass on mouth corners and lid crease

action: Crease Polish around the nose/mouth, then Grab on the jaw.
